cover_headline: Rupee Hits Seven-Month High Near ₹93.40, Squeezing IT Exporters' Earnings
facts: The Indian rupee climbed to around ₹93.39–₹93.41 per US dollar on November 18, its strongest level in seven months
Foreign institutional investors have returned as net buyers, putting a net ₹94,963 crore into Indian stocks through November 17
The benchmark Nifty IT index is down over 5.5% so far this month

end.headline: Rupee Hits Seven-Month High Near ₹93.40, Squeezing IT Exporters' Earnings
end.line: The rupee's rise, powered by foreign inflows and cheaper oil, cuts the rupee value of TCS and Infosys's dollar earnings.
